notes: Role is a judgment call (confidence low): the work calls itself an agent, but the step order is fixed; only human review verdicts (rollback) change the next action, and these are not tool outputs under R0. The final record adds a GH module and a TSK module that the blind pass merged into one TSK module; this follows the reconciliation of the general skill contract (Section 2.2) against the flood chain (Section 2.1). LLMs are used off the shelf with no training, so there is no LLM-side module. No GTS module is assigned: the chronological split and the retrieval-pool restriction in cross-validation are evaluation design, and Step 3 real-time updating is described in one sentence, so it is not modelled separately. Cost and latency figures are LLM costs, not decision utility, so decision_utility is absent. Glyph-garbled figure text was ignored. Work-level tasks now include decision_support because the warning bulletin is a decision output; the card listed only forecasting_prediction. The card's evidence locators were page-level and are replaced with verbatim line quotes.
